name: Blak Dot Gallery
watch: First Nations-led gallery in Brunswick, founded in 2011. Hosted the 2014 '18C' protest show against Racial Discrimination Act changes.

name: Lagos Biennial
watch: Artist-founded biennial led by Folakunle Oshun. Its 4th edition, 2024, ran in Tafawa Balewa Square.

name: Kin ArtStudio
watch: Residency and studio founded 2011 by Vitshois Mwilambwe Bondo in a former TEXAF textile hangar. Linked to the Congo Biennale.

name: Inema Arts Center
watch: Ten resident-artist slots at KG 563 St, Kacyiru.

name: blaxTARLINES KUMASI
watch: Ranked 69 in ArtReview's 2025 Power 100 and invited to the 2026 Venice Biennale main exhibition.

name: e-flux
watch: Artist-run company of Moscow-born Anton Vidokle; its Russian state and oligarch-funded clients ceased to post after the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

name: Laguna Art Museum
watch: Founded by local artists in 1918; collects California art from 1860 to the present, built almost entirely through gifts.
